member.name: M:vaudio.World.Update
member.summary:
Updates the raytracing simulation. Call this method regularly to process raytracing results and submit new work.
This method does nothing if background raytracing threads are still running. When threads are idle, it performs the following operations:
- Handles the last raytracing results, updating reverb objects and invoking callbacks
- Applies new settings and resizes memory buffers if needed (e.g., if ray counts were changed)
- Processes new, modified, and removed primitives
- Starts raytracing again on background threads
This method must be called from the main thread. The actual raytracing runs on background threads.
Calling this more frequently (multiple times per frame) is safe and can reduce latency for emitter updates.

When set to true, will stop submitting work to background threads.
When becomes false, it is safe to call .

member.name: P:vaudio.World.ReverbCalculated
member.summary: Returns true when raytracing has run at least once, and it is safe to access reverb objects

member.name: F:vaudio.World.GroupedEAX
member.summary: List of grouped EAX reverb properties for all emitters. Contains parameters compatible with EAX reverb effects.

member.name: F:vaudio.World.OnRaytracingCompleted
member.summary: This callback is invoked right after the background threads finish running. At this point, the results of the background threads have not been processed yet (EAX is not updated yet, low pass filters not updated, ambience not updated, etc). After this, will be invoked next.

member.name: F:vaudio.World.OnReverbUpdated
member.summary: This callback is invoked after EAX reverb results are updated. This gives you a chance to update your EAX effects, so they can be applied to an emitter in it's callback. After this, each emitter's callback are invoked, and then will be invoked next.

member.name: F:vaudio.World.OnRaytracingResultsHandled
member.summary: This callback is invoked after all raytracing results (EAX, filters, etc) have been processed. After this, new emitter/primitive settings will be applied, and the background threads will start again.
